name: Stolen Songs
description: The end of the road, and it is a room. Four walls, a floor, and a roof with a hole in it, and every surface is written on. Not carved: written, in a hand that changed many times and never once got larger or smaller. What is written here was taken from somewhere else and kept.

pois.label: Written walls
pois.text: Covered from the floor to as high as a person can reach standing, and then further, in lines that run level and tight. Several hands, one size. The ink is brown and has sunk into the stone.

pois.label: Hole in the roof
pois.text: A clean square, cut rather than fallen through. The light lands in a square on the floor and the floor inside that square is the only unwritten part of the room.

pois.label: The last line
pois.text: At the end of the final wall, at the height of a seated person's hand, the writing stops mid-line. The last word is unfinished and the stroke runs off the edge of the stone into the air.
